title: Next round after the 2026-10-12 fixes: order and policies

state.product: Zenno: booking + gift card + payments SaaS for German wellness/massage studios (Hamburg). Still internal, first live shop SATUUU99 (Strato mail, pay in shop, voucher Christmas sets running 07.10.-23.12.2026). Owner asked to stop pausing for questions.
state.owner_notes_2026_10_12: 1 migrate EasyWeek bookings/time blocks; 2 several therapists per time slot; 3 automatic confirmation by email to customer and owner; 3.1 mark pay-in-shop vouchers paid; 4 send from info@satuuu99.de; 5/9 SATUUU99 only: 'Gutscheine vor Ort get Geschenk' - pay the voucher in the shop to receive a gift; 11 Thai language; 12 E-Rechnung Germany.
state.done_today: Email relay closed; couple bookings use two therapists; shop closed days; one availability engine; therapist-choice switch; SMTP port 465 (waiting for SATUUU99 mailbox password); auto-confirm + customer/owner emails + day-before reminder via outbox and pg_cron; critical security fixes (admin accounts, tenant leaks, function auth); guest cancel link and payment success page; unpaid online holds released; date shift bugs; POS mark paid.

open_items.security_tidy: Small leaks: any signed-in user can overwrite another shop's logo in the shared storage bucket; a known gift card code can be attached to someone's customer account; get_gift_card_receipt returns code and balance to anyone with the card id. Each about 30-60 min.
open_items.reschedule_email: Moving a confirmed booking to a new time sends no email and the day-before reminder is silently dropped, so customers can come at the old time. About 1 h.
open_items.gift_card_restore: Gift card value or pass visits used on a booking are never returned when the booking is cancelled, even a week ahead. Shops have a cancellationHours setting (default 24). Also redemption happens after the booking insert, so a failed redemption leaves a confirmed booking. About 2-3 h.
open_items.couple_calendar: A couple booking blocks two therapists but the admin calendar and bookings list only show it under the first therapist; the second looks free. About 1-2 h.
open_items.gift_promo_satuuu99: Per-order bonus note and 'handed over' tick exist in admin, but customers don't see a gift message when ordering. Needs a per-shop promo text on the voucher page, set for SATUUU99. About 1 h. SATUUU99 promotion is running now until 23.12.
open_items.easyweek_import: No importer for customers/bookings/time blocks from EasyWeek. Needs EasyWeek's CSV export format; a generic CSV importer with column mapping could be built without the file. About 4-6 h.
open_items.invoices: No invoice/receipt PDF, numbering or tax IDs. B2C salons don't need E-Rechnung; B2B issuing becomes mandatory 2027 (>800k turnover) / 2028 (all). About 1 day for invoice PDF + numbering, more for ZUGFeRD.
open_items.thai_language: UI has en/de only; Thai would be a full translation set. About 1 day.

state.market_reference: Fresha, Treatwell, Shore, Planity and EasyWeek all: send booking confirmation + reminder + reschedule notification emails/SMS; restore prepaid value or credit on in-policy cancellations and keep it for late cancellations; show multi-staff/group appointments in every involved staff column; offer CSV import of clients and appointments during onboarding (switching cost is the main sales objection); support German invoices with sequential numbers and tax ID (Treatwell/Shore), E-Rechnung via DATEV export at most. Gift card promos (bonus on purchase) are common around Christmas.
state.constraints: One developer (Claude) working continuously; production deploys verified live; SATUUU99 is the only real shop and its Christmas promo is live now.

first_item.instructions: Which open item should be built first? The distribution is used as the overall build order.

criteria.security_tidy: Close the three small security leaks first.
criteria.gift_card_restore: Restore gift card value on in-policy cancellations (and make redemption atomic) first.
criteria.couple_calendar: Show couple bookings under both therapists first.
criteria.gift_promo_satuuu99: SATUUU99 gift promo text on the voucher page first (promotion is live now).
criteria.easyweek_import: Generic CSV import (clients, bookings, time blocks) for EasyWeek migration first.
criteria.invoices: Invoice PDF with numbering and tax IDs first.

gift_card_cancel_policy.instructions: When a booking paid (partly) with a gift card or service pass is cancelled, what happens to the redeemed value?

criteria.restore_before_window: Restore the value/visit if cancelled before the shop's cancellation window (cancellationHours, default 24 h); keep it for late cancellations and no-shows. Admin cancellations always restore.
criteria.always_restore: Always restore on any cancellation; late fees handled separately.
criteria.never_restore: Never restore automatically; the shop adjusts balances by hand.

couple_display.instructions: How should a couple booking appear for the second therapist in calendar and bookings list?

criteria.both_columns_linked: Show the same booking in both therapists' columns with a 'Couple' badge naming the partner; editing either opens the one booking.
criteria.first_column_badge: Keep it under the first therapist only but add a badge with the second therapist's name.

easyweek_approach.instructions: How to start the EasyWeek migration without the owner's export file?

criteria.generic_csv_mapping: Build a generic CSV import (customers, upcoming bookings, time blocks) with a column-mapping step and German/English header auto-detection; EasyWeek's export maps onto it.
criteria.wait_for_file: Wait for a real EasyWeek export before building anything.
criteria.manual_service: Offer to import for the shop by hand (SQL) when they send the file.

invoice_scope.instructions: What invoice scope for the German market now?

criteria.invoice_pdf_first: Invoice/receipt PDF with sequential numbering, Steuernummer/USt-IdNr, VAT lines and Kleinunternehmer note; ZUGFeRD later for B2B.
criteria.later: Postpone invoices until a shop asks.
